case.summary: A failed verification after a change restores every target of the change.
Undo of a created file removes it.
Undo of an overwrite restores the previous bytes.
Undo of an append restores the previous length.
Undo of a prepend restores the previous bytes.
Undo of a batch of writes restores every file of the batch as one operation.

step.program:
write files: [{path: "${base}/n.txt", text: "new
", mode: "create"}, {path: "${base}/a.txt", text: "gamma
", mode: "append"}, {path: "${base}/b.txt", text: "B
", mode: "overwrite"}]

case.summary: Undo of a truncation restores the removed bytes.
Undo of an extension restores the previous length.
Undo of a written registry value removes the value.
A write to a special file is reported as irreversible.
Undo of a replacement restores the previous bytes.
Undo of an insertion restores the previous bytes.
Undo of an insertion at the end restores the previous length.
Undo of an edit restores the previous bytes.
Undo of a copied tree removes the copy.
Undo of a copy onto an existing file restores the destination.
Undo of a copied registry value removes the copy.
Undo of a move onto an existing file restores both files.
Undo of a move to a new name restores the old name.
Undo of a moved registry value restores it under its old name.
Undo of a removed directory tree restores every entry.
Undo of several removed files restores all of them as one operation.
Undo of removed lines restores the previous bytes.
Undo of a removed registry value restores it.
Removing a finished job is reported as irreversible.
Undo of a move to another volume restores the file on both volumes.
Undo of a created temporary file removes it.
Undo of a rename restores the old name.
Undo of a created file removes it.
Undo of created directories removes them, parents included.
Undo of a created symbolic link removes the link and keeps its target.
Undo of a created hard link removes the link and keeps the file.

step.program: create "h.txt" type: link target: "${base}/a.txt" hard: true

case.summary: Undo of a created junction removes it and keeps its target.
Undo of a touch restores the previous modification time.
Undo of a mode change restores the previous mode.
Undo of a changed modification time restores the previous time.
Undo of a program run restores the watched files the program changed.

step.program: run ["sh", "-c", "echo new > a.txt; echo b > b.txt"] cwd: "${base}" watch: ["${base}"]

case.summary: A watched file changed without a kept copy is reported as irreversible.
Stopping a job is reported as irreversible.
Undo of a retried program restores the files of the retry only.

step.program: run ["sh", "-c", "echo x >> log.txt"] cwd: "${base}" background: true

case.summary: A retry that changes a file without a kept copy is reported as irreversible.

step.program: run ["sh", "-c", "echo x >> log.txt"] cwd: "${base}" background: true

case.summary: The undo entry keeps the restored items, so its redo returns the state after the change.
Undo of a redo restores the state before the redo.
Undo of a changed document value restores the previous bytes.
Undo of a database change restores the content of the database.

step.program: sql "app.db" "create table t(x integer)" write: true
sql "app.db" "insert into t values (1)" write: true

case.summary: Undo of a created database removes the database and its side files.

step.program: sql "app.db" "create table t(x integer)" write: true

case.summary: Undo of an applied patch restores the previous bytes.

step.program:
patch "--- a/a.txt
+++ b/a.txt
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 one
-two
+TWO
" root: "${base}" strip: 1

case.summary: Undo of a patch that creates and deletes files restores both.
Undo of a line ending conversion restores the previous bytes.
Undo of an encoding conversion restores the previous bytes.

Undo of formatting restores the source files.
Undo of a removed document key restores the previous bytes.
Undo of a created document removes it.
Undo of a rename onto an existing file restores both files.
Undo of a changed read-only attribute restores the previous attribute.
Undo of a background job restores the watched files that the job changed.

step.program: run ["sh", "-c", "echo new > a.txt"] cwd: "${base}" background: true watch: ["${base}"]

case.summary: A program that matches a pattern of effects outside the computer is reported as irreversible.
Undo of a patch that adds a file removes the file.
Undo of a patch that deletes a file restores the file.
Undo of a patch that renames a file restores the name.

step.program:
patch "diff --git a/b.txt b/r.txt
similarity index 100%
rename from b.txt
rename to r.txt
" root: "${base}" strip: 1

case.summary: Undo of a patch that changes a mode restores the mode.

step.program:
patch "diff --git a/a.txt b/a.txt
old mode 100644
new mode 100755
" root: "${base}" strip: 1
